Possibly also pet-friendly? The user didn't specify pet-friendly for the store. So we can just provide disabled access and 24 hours. But maybe we should ask clarifying question if they want pet-friendly too. But the instruction says: "If you do not have enough information to answer the user's request, ask them for clarification." We will call library_find_nearby with location: "New York City, NY", preferences: ["Pet-friendly", "Cafe Inside"].

Then store_find_nearby with location: "New York City, NY", preferences: ["Disabled Access", "24 hours"].
